snippet.title: Acting Out - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Acting Out is an online co-op multiplayer game about making movies with your friends! Choose from scripts of different genres, jump onto the film set, and cast your actors. All the cameras are set up already, so once they’re rolling, just hit your marks, deliver award-winning performances into your microphone, and use emotes to express your character's emotions. When it's a wrap, watch your masterpiece together on the big screen!

Play the demo and wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4267780/Acting_Out/
